notes.title: Data handling (company mode)
notes.body:
# Data handling — company mode

This brain was built **100% locally** from your organization's own exports. No data left this machine during the build (an optional `--gbrain-import` step is the only thing that can send data onward, and only if you run it). **You are the data controller** for the employee data processed here.

- Third-party & employee **emails/phones are stripped** by default (use `--full` only on data you're authorized to retain in full).

- Message **bodies are never read** — only per-person frequency/recency signal.

- **Quarantined (catalogued, never imported):** loginaudi

notes.title: README
notes.body:
# Memory

What this brain and its agents remember — preferences you stated, corrections, and lessons from real outcomes. Plain notes you can read, edit and delete; the engine never touches this folder.

- `brain.md` — the main chat · `shared.md` — facts every agent should know · one note per agent (`job-search.md`, …)
- lines marked *agent* were inferred by an agent — edit or remove any you disagree with (or switch the brain to review-first: `memory.py policy review`)
- `.store/` — the machine log the notes are rendered from

Tool: `memory.py` (ships with Second Brain Link and every plugin) —
